name: Parker
source:
A clever and mischievous witch who loves experimenting and trying out new potions. Rules and structure are not their thing, they'd much rather go with the flow.

Although they're a bit of a recluse, Parker enjoys Rue's company more than they care to admit.

[From [url=https://prikarin.itch.io/potion-pleasing]itch.io[/url]]
